decision: The current signed net forces do not load the short upper leg end, the NDS quarter-offset merging condition is not triggered, and projected member axes pass through the equally weighted pair centroid. The earlier7D upper-leg sensitivity is not the applicable signed-force load branch. No bolt move is justified by these concerns.
limits: This resolves the stated signed-net-force geometry questions only. It does not assign Cg=1 by calling every station a singleton, or qualify complete oblique row/end/edge geometry by interpolation.
The grain-axis spacing checks use the actual physical member axes. In particular perpendicular-to-grain row spacing is the grainwise separation, not the cross-grain separation.

Source out-of-plane forces, own couples and differing individual force directions are preserved; they are not absorbed into a uniform group force. Complete simultaneous-action resistance, transverse transfer and actual center of nonlinear resistance remain separate.
Current upper leg ends are angled; their physical grain-ray distances and all source moments remain authoritative. No actual complete connection-wide Cdelta or capacity is assigned.
question: Do the current upper-pair loads trigger staggered-row merging or load the short upper leg end, and do the member axes meet the equally weighted bolt centroid?

standards.NDS2024_11_3_6_2: For Cg, staggered adjacent rows merge when between-row offset is less than one quarter of the closest grain-independent along-row separation. Use the actual considered load axis; do not substitute grain pitch for that axis.
standards.NDS2024_12_5_1: The recorded ordinary signed-force end branch is 4D at the upper leg end, because all net grain forces act away from it; the opposite loaded end remains distant. Oblique end applicability and full independent couples remain separate.
standards.NDS2024_12_6_2: Member gravity axes should pass through the group center of resistance for angle-to-grain multiple-fastener loading. The present geometry check uses equal weighting of the two identical-diameter stations and projects normal to the bolt axis.

stopping_condition: Check two current pairs, four physical profiles and 48 existing receiver wrenches in six cases; preserve complete source couples. No native, frame or CAD execution.
